name: Hair of the Dog
summary: Customers' hair keeps turning up in the wrong cellars, and Randall Graham cannot explain it.

stages.journal: Randall Graham's customers' hair keeps turning up in the funeral home's basement, and he cannot say why.
stages.hint: Look at the jars in the barber's cellar and the funeral home's basement, then see Randall.

stages.journal: We found out why the hair travels, and what Randall does about it.
